description: This file contains a fake implementation of the CalendarAccountEventFactory used for unit testing within the CalendarSync module of a CRM system. It provides in-memory object creation methods to avoid database access during tests, simulating the creation of CalendarAccountEvent objects from Meeting, Call, and Task beans, with logic to determine event end times and types.

classes.name: FakeCalendarAccountEventFactory
classes.description: A test double class that extends CalendarAccountEventFactory, used to create CalendarAccountEvent objects from beans without database interaction, including logic to set event times and types based on bean properties.

methods.name: fromMeetingBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Meeting object, delegating to fromBean.

methods.name: fromCallBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Call object, delegating to fromBean.

methods.name: fromTaskBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Task object, delegating to fromBean.

methods.name: fromBean
methods.description: Constructs a CalendarAccountEvent based on the bean's object type, setting start/end times and type appropriately.

methods.name: fromSourceEvent
methods.description: Creates a new CalendarAccountEvent based on an existing event, copying properties and adjusting external status.

methods.name: createDateTime
methods.description: Helper method to safely parse a date string into a DateTime object, returning null if invalid or empty.
